Stan program and data from a formula carrying a trend_formula

Source: R/make_stan.R
trend_formula_generation.Rd

stancode() and standata() delegate a plain formula to brms. A trend_formula in the same call, or a family mvgam builds such as tweedie() or nmix(), names an mvgam model. These methods then build the mvgam_formula that call describes and generate its program.

Usage

# S3 method for formula
stancode(object, ...)

# S3 method for bform
stancode(object, ...)

# S3 method for formula
standata(object, ...)

# S3 method for bform
standata(object, ...)

Arguments

object

A formula, or a brmsformula or mvbrmsformula (both of class bform).

...

Arguments for stancode.mvgam_formula or for brms, data and family among them.

Value

A character string of Stan code, or a list of Stan data.

See also

mvgam_formula, stancode.mvgam_formula, standata.mvgam_formula
